description: Execute a DAX query against a semantic model. Returns tabular results.
notes: When Direct Lake framing is needed, submit once and retain the refresh/generator receipt. Only correlationStatus:verified establishes refreshId; verify that exact request before querying and never blindly resubmit accepted/unknown work. Query readiness is not source compatibility or freshness. DAX must use EVALUATE for table results or DEFINE + EVALUATE for measures. Use double quotes for DAX strings inside the query.

query_examples.description: Column names from the DAX result.
